executive_summary: US equity futures and post-market trading are experiencing a violent relief rally led by semiconductors and AI infrastructure following the dramatic reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of NVIDIA. The market has posted its strongest single-day gain since April 2025, completely reversing the tech correction. However, emerging macro risks—specifically naval mine strikes on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz—require tactical agility despite broad-based tech euphoria.

recommendations.strategy: Scale into core positions on minor intraday pullbacks; utilize trailing stop-losses given upcoming congressional testimony on Dec 1.
recommendations.risk: Geopolitical and regulatory scrutiny around AI export controls and supply chain security.
